name: Bay Area Casual Carpool
description: Free rides for passengers; reduced tolls and HOV access for drivers
fullDescription: Casual carpooling (also called "slugging") is an informal ridesharing system for commuting to San Francisco. Drivers and passengers meet at designated pickup spots in the East Bay and form carpools of three to use HOV lanes and the discounted Bay Bridge carpool toll.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free rides for passengers to San Francisco
- Discounted Bay Bridge carpool toll for drivers (FasTrak required)
- HOV lane access for drivers
- No formal registration required
- About two dozen pickup locations in the East Bay, Vallejo, and Fairfield
howToGetIt:
1. Find a casual carpool pickup location near you on 511.org
2. Line up at designated spots during commute hours
3. Drivers pull up and passengers get in (carpools of three)
4. Ride is free for passengers
5. Drivers benefit from carpool toll rates and HOV access
keywords: casual carpool, slugging, free ride, HOV, bridge toll, Bay Bridge, carpool lane, commute, San Francisco, East Bay
